_about: Thresholds and settings of the timing perception layer (TIMING-SPEC.md). One key per measure: '<lane or view>.<measure>': {value, unit, about}. A lane's effective settings are its code defaults, then these values, then signals(settings={lane: {...}}). Changing a value here recomputes only the lanes that use it (it is part of each lane's cache identity). Calibrate against human choices by editing values, not code. Owners add their own keys (B1: store, frame_features, motion, visual_beats, motion_events, attention, shots, audio, map, slow).

attention.face_hold_frames.about: a face detection is used for frames up to this far from it (same shot)

attention.motion_norm_px.about: residual motion this strong counts fully

attention.sharpen.about: the map is raised to this power before its weighted centre is taken

attention.w_faces.about: faces (a Gaussian per face by size and score)

attention.w_motion.about: residual motion (camera removed), normalised by motion_norm_px

attention.w_saliency.about: still-image saliency (normalised to its frame maximum)

frame_features.analysis_px.about: long side of decoded frames (faces run at this size)

frame_features.border.about: margin of each side left out of the motion measures

frame_features.face_every.about: faces are detected on every n-th frame (frame index multiple of n)

frame_features.fit_px.about: RANSAC inlier distance of the camera similarity fit (flow size)

frame_features.fit_step.about: the flow is sampled every this many px for the camera fit

frame_features.flow_preset.about: OpenCV DIS preset: ultrafast | fast | medium

frame_features.flow_px.about: long side of the grey frames dense optical flow runs on; motion energy is px/frame at this size

frame_features.grid_cells.about: cells of the coarse saliency and motion grids used by attention

frame_features.move_px.about: a pixel moves when its residual flow is at least this (moving share)

frame_features.region_px.about: strongest moving region: cells moving at least this

frame_features.region_rel.about: ... and at least this share of the strongest cell

frame_features.sal_px.about: long side of the frame spectral-residual saliency runs on

frame_features.workers.about: frame-pair worker threads (OpenCV at 1 thread each; not part of the chunk cache identity). Kept low: the PC hard-crashed under combined load on 28 Oct

joins.click_min_dbfs.about: a discontinuity quieter than this is not a click

joins.click_ratio.about: AR(32) prediction-error peak at the join over the typical peaks around it (lossless sound; synthetic joins in real speech: 97% of hard cuts/impulses over it, 1% of untouched positions)

joins.click_ratio_lossy.about: the same for AAC/MP3/Opus sound (through AAC 128k: 79% recall, 3% false alarms)

joins.clip_ms.about: the cut takes more than this off the last word's end or the next word's start (measured on the recordings)

joins.floor_jump_db.about: noise floor (room tone) change, non-speech frames within 1.5 s each side

joins.level_jump_lu.about: momentary (0.4 s) loudness change; speech next to a pause makes up to 17 LU

joins.min_thought_pause_s.about: a thought end left with less pause than this ...

joins.pitch_jump_st.about: speaking pitch change across a dialogue join (letitedit-fine FINE-4)

joins.room_spectral_jump_db.about: room tone spectral envelope change (quietest non-speech frames)

joins.silence_gap_s.about: digital silence (< -90 dBFS) this long touching the join is a hole

joins.source_pause_ratio.about: ... and under this share of the recording's own pause there is tightened (FINE-1)

joins.spectral_jump_db.about: voice spectral envelope change (median log-mel 100 Hz-8 kHz, level removed, 8 DCT terms)

joins.speech_level_jump_lu.about: loudness change of the speech frames within 3 s each side

joins.window_s.about: fallback spectra window each side when a side has too little speech

joins.word_clear_after_s.about: a join closer than this before the next word's start clips its onset

joins.word_clear_before_s.about: a join closer than this after the last word ends clips its tail (FINE-3)

meaning.cam_drift.about: measured camera: net travel above this means handheld

meaning.cam_jitter.about: measured camera: shake above this means handheld

meaning.camera_from.about: 'measured' (camera lane / camera shifts) or 'model' for handheld / locked off

meaning.chunk.about: items per model call; the GPU turn is let go between calls

meaning.design.about: frames shown per item: '3f' before/peak/after, '6f' six frames, 'strip' one tiled image

meaning.fb_cut_guard_s.about: fallback events: frames this close to a cut are not motion

meaning.fb_floor_pct.about: fallback events: the quiet level percentile

meaning.fb_floor_s.about: fallback events: window of the running quiet level

meaning.fb_k_on.about: fallback events: rise above the quiet level that starts an event

meaning.fb_max_event_s.about: fallback events: longer ones are split at their deepest dips

meaning.fb_merge_gap_s.about: fallback events: closer events are merged

meaning.fb_min_dur_s.about: fallback events: shorter ones are dropped

meaning.fb_min_excess.about: fallback events: smallest rise that starts an event

meaning.fb_off_ratio.about: fallback events: an event lasts while above this share of the rise threshold

meaning.fb_smooth_s.about: fallback events: residual change smoothed over this

meaning.max_items.about: most items the model labels in one call (shots first, then events by strength)

meaning.min_accuracy.about: label types measured under this are marked ~ and not trusted

meaning.min_event_s.about: shorter motion events are left unlabelled

meaning.near_match.about: cached answers are reused for frames whose 16x16 grey thumbnails differ under this

meaning.post_s.about: an event's 'after' frame this long after its end (inside its shot)

meaning.pre_s.about: an event's 'before' frame this long before its onset (inside its shot)

meaning.preview_px.about: long side of this module's own project preview (only without the store)

meaning.shot_margin_s.about: a shot's first and last frame shown this far inside it

meaning.shot_max_s.about: shots longer than this are labelled in parts of at most this length

meaning.vocabulary.about: answers offered for what happens (general, repair, travel, talk)

meaning.width.about: width of each frame shown to the model

meaning.words.about: give the model the words said in the item as context

motion.direction_min_coherence.about: ... and its vectors agree this much

motion.direction_min_energy.about: direction only where the strongest region moves at least this ...

motion.handheld_jitter.about: shake (RMS of the per-frame camera move around its smooth_s mean, over jitter_s) at least this: handheld

motion.handheld_speed.about: otherwise a camera drifting at least this, or shaking at least handheld_jitter: handheld; else static

motion.jitter_s.about: handheld: spread of the frame-to-frame camera motion around that mean, over this

motion.min_label_s.about: camera label runs shorter than this merge into their neighbours

motion.min_trust.about: camera estimates where fewer flow samples agree are counted as untrusted

motion.pan_shake_ratio.about: see pan_speed: a steady move shakes little relative to its speed

motion.pan_speed.about: camera speed at least this with shake under pan_shake_ratio x speed: pan (sideways) or tilt (up/down)

motion.smooth_s.about: camera speed is judged on a centred mean over this (within a shot)

motion.steady_max_jitter.about: see steady_pan_speed (a tripod or gimbal move, not a hand)

motion.steady_pan_speed.about: a slower camera move is a pan / tilt too when it is steady: speed at least this and shake under steady_max_jitter

motion.unreliable_speed.about: a camera move faster than this with an untrusted fit (motion blur): subject motion cannot be separated; energy there is None (listed in unmeasured)

motion.whip_smooth_s.about: whips are judged on a centred mean over this shorter window (they are fast and short)

motion.whip_speed.about: camera speed on the whip window (whip_smooth_s) at least this: whip. Calibrated on 221 hand-labelled 0.5 s bins of 8 raw clips

motion.zoom_rate.about: zoom rate at least this, and the zoom motion at the frame corners >= zoom_dominance x camera speed: zoom

motion_events.edge_share.about: onset and end: where energy falls back under rest + this share of the rise

motion_events.rest_pct.about: a shot's resting motion level: this percentile of its energy

motion_events.rise_mad.about: ... and this many median absolute deviations of the shot's energy

motion_events.rise_px.about: an event rises at least this above the resting level ...

motion_events.signal.about: what must rise for an event: energy (the frame mean of residual motion), p90 (its 90th percentile) or rmag (the mean motion of the strongest moving region; catches small movements). On 25 labelled actions: energy with rise_px 0.5 found 23, rmag with rise_px 2.0 found 24, edges alike

motion_events.smooth_s.about: energy smoothed over this (centred mean within a shot)

shots.black_luma.about: a shot whose median luma is under this ...

shots.black_std.about: ... and luma spread under this is black

shots.closeup_face.about: median height of the largest face at least this: closeup

shots.medium_face.about: ... at least this: medium; under it: wide

shots.min_face_share.about: a face must be found in at least this share of a shot's checked frames, else size unknown

speech.activity_anchor_s.about: ... and within this of voicing (machines and wind far from voice are not speech)

speech.activity_db.about: speech activity: unvoiced sound at least this far over the local floor ...

speech.activity_share.about: ... and this share of the way from the floor to the speech level ...

speech.breath.excess_db.about: a breath raises the 400-4000 Hz bands this far over the local noise floor spectrum, unvoiced

speech.breath.max_jitter_db.about: median frame-to-frame change of that excess; more is a knock or clicks (fitted on spectrogram labels, 28 Oct 2026)

speech.breath.min_breadth.about: share of the 400-4000 Hz bands raised 3 dB or more (0 = off)

speech.breath.min_pause_s.about: pauses shorter than this are not searched for breaths

speech.breath.min_plateau.about: share of the run's frames within 6 dB of its peak; less is one knock

speech.key_line_space_s.about: space after a key line under this is noted (craft P4: hold after the line)

speech.long_pause_s.about: a pause this long inside a thought is listed as drag (letitedit-fine FINE-1)

speech.no_reset_s.about: craft P5: no stretch this long without a thought end or breath

speech.pause_min_s.about: a silence between words this long is listed as a pause

speech.stress.function_word_factor.about: function words' stress is multiplied by this

speech.stress.min.about: a word with stress at least this is listed as stressed (about 12% of words)

speech.stress.w_duration.about: lengthening against the syllables' usual time

speech.stress.w_energy.about: energy peak over the local speech level

speech.stress.w_f0.about: pitch peak over the local median (robust z) in the prominence

speech.thought_end.fall_st.about: final lowering cue: the last word ends this far under the median pitch of the 1.5 s before

speech.thought_end.incomplete_penalty.about: strength taken off after such a word

speech.thought_end.lengthening.about: slowing cue: the last word lasts this many times its syllables' usual time (pre-boundary lengthening)

speech.thought_end.lexical.about: 1: a boundary after a word that cannot end a phrase (the, and, of, I, to ...) loses incomplete_penalty; 0: acoustic cues only

speech.thought_end.min_strength.about: a word boundary with this strength or more is a thought end

speech.thought_end.pause_full_s.about: a pause this long scores the full pause cue (0 at 100 ms)

speech.thought_end.pause_s.about: pause cue of a thought end (Biron et al. 2021: about 300 ms is the best single pause threshold for intonation-unit boundaries)

speech.thought_end.rate_ratio.about: slowing cue: the last three words' rate under this share of the speaker's median rate

speech.thought_end.reset_st.about: pitch reset cue: the next words start this much higher

speech.thought_end.w_breath.about: breath-in-the-pause cue weight (0: added nothing on held-out clips)

speech.thought_end.w_final_lowering.about: final lowering cue weight (0: added nothing on held-out clips)

speech.thought_end.w_pause.about: pause cue weight in the thought-end strength (tuned 28 Oct 2026 on weak text labels of the quick clips)

speech.thought_end.w_pitch_reset.about: pitch reset cue weight (0: added nothing on held-out clips)

store.max_whole_s.about: sources up to this long are analysed whole; longer ones only around the asked range

store.pad_s.about: a long source's asked range is widened by this much each side

store.preview_px.about: long side of a project's preview render (melt)

sync.beat_clear_min.about: beat_quality clear at or above this (synthetic and clear songs 0.75-1.0; songs without a steady beat about 0.5)
sync.beat_clear_min.unit: mean Beat This! beat probability at the beats

sync.beat_weak_min.about: beat_quality weak at or above this, none below
sync.beat_weak_min.unit: mean Beat This! beat probability at the beats

sync.gap_min_s.about: speech gaps (between the padded words) shorter than this are not checked for a music swell

sync.hard_hit_min_strength.about: a downbeat or phrase start at least this strong counts as a hard hit when a cut lands within sync.near_beat_frames of it
sync.hard_hit_min_strength.unit: 0-1 onset strength at the beat (song percentile scale)

sync.hard_hit_sound_lead_frames.about: reference, not a rule (AOTC Dune, letitedit-sound): on a hard hit the sound sits about half a frame before the cut

sync.monotony_run.about: a run of this many consecutive on-beat cuts is reported as a long run

sync.monotony_share.about: an on-beat share of cuts at or above this is reported as possibly mechanical (every cut on the beat); reported with its number, not judged

sync.motion_peak_rel.about: fallback motion peaks (when the motion lanes are not registered): residual frame difference at least this many times the shot median
sync.motion_peak_rel.unit: x the median of the shot

sync.music_under_speech_db.about: music closer than this to the dialogue loudness under words is listed (reference: the score op sits music 18 dB under)

sync.on_beat_frames.about: an event at most this far from a beat (either side) is counted as on the beat (monotony runs, on-beat share)

sync.section_match_bars.about: a story boundary within this many bars of a song boundary (section, phrase start, drop or join) counts as aligned

sync.sfx_match_frames.about: an SFX onset within this of its impact counts as on the impact

sync.sfx_window_frames.about: a motion peak or cut within this of an SFX onset is taken as the impact it belongs to

sync.swell_rise_db.about: the music level in a speech gap this much above its level under the words around it counts as rising in the pause

trajectory.breath_dip.about: a dip just before the peak at least this deep counts as a breath

trajectory.breath_window_s.about: just before a planned peak: a dip here is a breath (release before the peak)

trajectory.gear_rank_min.about: rank correlation between planned gears and the sections' measured index at or above this is reported as matching order

trajectory.music_floor_db.about: music level used for the index where no music plays

trajectory.release_min.about: a fall after the peak at least this big counts as a release

trajectory.release_window_s.about: after a planned peak: compared with the peak

trajectory.rise_min.about: a rise at least this big counts as rising into the peak

trajectory.rise_window_s.about: before a planned peak: the last window is compared with the window before it (rise into the peak)

trajectory.weights.about: weights of the robust z-scores in the energy index (a measure without variation in this edit is left out)

trajectory.window_s.about: centred window of every series value

visual_beats.edge_frames.about: no beats this close to a cut, nor inside a transition

visual_beats.min_abs.about: a beat's absolute drop (summed over directions), at least this

visual_beats.min_gap_s.about: beats closer than this: the stronger is kept

visual_beats.min_speed_before.about: the most motion within stop_s before a beat must be at least this: a stop needs a movement to stop (still pictures make no beats)

visual_beats.min_strength.about: a beat's envelope peak relative to the local scale, at least this

visual_beats.scale_s.about: local scale: the envelope's 90th percentile within +- this

visual_beats.smooth_frames.about: the impact envelope is smoothed over this many frames

visual_beats.stop_s.about: f_stop: the local minimum of motion speed within this after the peak

cuts.move_speed.about: a pixel moves when its camera-compensated flow is at least this (frame diagonals per second, flow at 256 px): moving share, motion arrows

cuts.action_speed.about: a frame has action when its subject speed (median speed of its most moving region, camera removed) is at least this (a talking head moves ~0.15-0.25; 85th percentile of the last frames before 398 professional cuts)

cuts.frame_wide_share.about: motion over this share of the frame is frame-wide (camera parallax or a frame-filling subject), not a local action: no direction, no masking

cuts.post_motion_masks.about: local motion this fast over B's first 0.3 s lowers eye-trace findings one step (Smith & Martin-Portugues 2017)

cuts.eye_jump_noticeable.about: the attention point jumps at least this across the cut: noticeable (75th percentile of 398 professional cuts: Tears of Steel, Sintel, Big Buck Bunny, Caminandes)

cuts.direction_min_coherence.about: local motion has a direction when its vectors agree this much

cuts.direction_reversed_deg.about: directions of local motion this far apart across the cut: screen direction reverses (noticeable)

cuts.direction_same_deg.about: directions this close: the motion keeps its direction

cuts.pan_speed.about: the picture shifts at least this fast: the camera pans or tilts

cuts.jump_framing_sim.about: A's last and B's first frame match at least this after camera compensation: same framing (jump cut unless the size changes)

cuts.jump_layout_sim.about: ... or their 1/8-size layouts match at least this

cuts.jump_max_cells.about: ... and at most this share of the 4x4 cells changed their local texture (a shared gradient or vignette alone is not the same framing)

cuts.same_size_ratio.about: face heights within this ratio: the same shot size

cuts.punch_zoom.about: the same picture reframed by at least this zoom: a punch-in

cuts.luma_jump_noticeable.about: mean brightness changes at least this across the cut: noticeable (75th percentile of 398 professional cuts)

cuts.luma_jump_jarring.about: ... at least this: jarring, a flash (their 99th percentile)

cuts.blank_flat_share.about: a frame with at least this share of its pixels within 2 levels of its median is blank (black, white or flat, a caption on it allowed)

cuts.blur_mask_ratio.about: A's last frames at most this sharp (Laplacian variance) relative to the sharpest frame of its window while the frame moves: the cut hides in motion blur (a whip), eye-trace findings one step lower

cuts.scene_hist.about: colour histogram change at least this with unrelated framing: a new place or subject (reported, not scored)

cuts.flash_frames.about: a shot this short or shorter is a flash frame (jarring)

cuts.short_shot_frames.about: a shot this short or shorter is noticeable

cuts.gap_jarring_frames.about: empty (black) frames between two shots: fewer than this read as a glitch (jarring), more as a deliberate pause (noticeable)

cuts.many_noticeable.about: this many noticeable findings at one cut make it jarring

cuts.face_attention_min_h.about: a face this tall or taller is the attention point

cuts.same_person_cos.about: SFace features this similar: the same person (OpenCV threshold)

cuts.overlay_diff.about: textured pixels this close on both sides of a cut that changes the picture: a static overlay (caption, logo), masked out of the attention point

cuts.sound_level_jump_db.about: used only when the joins view reports a level jump without its own flag
